regions_section.title: 6 Geographic Regions of Morocco
regions_section.subtitle: Click a region to reveal 5, 7 and 10-day curated circuits.

imperial_5.title: 5-Day Express Triangle: Casablanca, Rabat & Marrakech
imperial_5.desc: Tailored for short-stay travelers, culture lovers, and professionals seeking a high-efficiency immersion. Connect Morocco's economic powerhouse, its serene coastal capital, and the vibrant Red City smoothly via high-speed train and modern expressways.

imperial_7.title: 7-Day Imperial Capitals Circuit: Casablanca, Rabat, Fes & Marrakech
imperial_7.desc: The classic grand tour connecting all major historical powerhouses of Morocco. Trace centuries of royal dynasties from Atlantic ports to Roman Volubilis, medieval Fes, and vibrant Marrakech.

imperial_10.title: 10-Day Complete Grand Tour: Imperial Cities & Merzouga Sahara
imperial_10.desc: The comprehensive Moroccan expedition combining Casablanca, Rabat, Fes, the Middle Atlas cedar forests of Azrou, Merzouga sand dunes, Dades Gorges, and Marrakech in one seamless trip.

north_5.title: 5-Day Northern Pearl Trail: Tangier, Asilah & Chefchaouen
north_5.desc: Where Mediterranean breeze meets Andalusian-Moorish heritage. Experience literary Tangier, the artists' coastal retreat of Asilah, and the world-famous blue-washed streets of Chefchaouen nestled in the Rif Mountains.

north_7.title: 7-Day Northern Highlights, Akchour Waterfalls & Fes Medina
north_7.desc: Combine the bohemian Mediterranean vibe of Tangier, the mountain hikes of Akchour waterfalls, the blue magic of Chefchaouen, and the imperial spiritual heritage of Fes and Volubilis in a single week.

north_10.title: 10-Day Complete Northern & Mediterranean Coast Loop
north_10.desc: An exhaustive northern exploration connecting Tangier, Tetouan medina, Smir coast, Chefchaouen, Al Hoceima Mediterranean National Park, and ending in Fes.

south_5.title: 5-Day Sahara Express: Marrakech, Ouarzazate & Merzouga Dunes
south_5.desc: An intense and memorable desert gateway designed to experience the majestic dunes of Erg Chebbi without missing Marrakech. Ideal for travelers with tight schedules who want to sleep in a desert bivouac.

south_7.title: 7-Day Grand South: Marrakech to Merzouga & Fes Medina
south_7.desc: Morocco's most popular road trip. Seamlessly link Marrakech, the High Atlas, the ancient Kasbahs of Ouarzazate, Todra Gorges, Merzouga's high dunes, and finish in spiritual Fes.

south_10.title: 10-Day Deep Sahara & Draâ Valley Expedition: Erg Chigaga 4x4 Track
south_10.desc: An authentic off-the-beaten-path road trip for nature lovers and adventurers. Travel down Morocco's longest palm grove, explore ancient earthen Kasbahs, and drive 3 hours off-road to the wild, untouched dunes of Erg Chigaga.

atlantic_5.title: 5-Day Atlantic Breeze: Essaouira, Imsouane & Taghazout Surf Spots
atlantic_5.desc: A relaxing coastal getaway to recharge to the rhythm of the ocean. Blend artistic Mogador (Essaouira), women-run Argan cooperatives, longboard surfing in Imsouane's Magic Bay, and rooftop yoga in Taghazout.

atlantic_7.title: 7-Day Marrakech & Atlantic Coast Combo: Souks to Waves
atlantic_7.desc: Combine the vibrant energy of Marrakech's palaces and souks with a refreshing coastal trip to Essaouira, Paradise Valley natural rock pools, and Taghazout.

atlantic_10.title: 10-Day Deep Atlantic & Anti-Atlas Coastal Expedition: Mirleft to Legzira Arches
atlantic_10.desc: Explore Morocco's dramatic southwestern coast where red ochre cliffs meet wild ocean waves. Drive from Essaouira through Agadir, Tiznit silver markets, Mirleft cliffs, and the massive red sand Arches of Legzira Beach down to Sidi Ifni.

atlas_5.title: 5-Day High Atlas & Berber Valleys Gateway: Imlil, Ourika & Ouzoud
atlas_5.desc: A mountain adventure designed for nature enthusiasts and active travelers. Base yourself near Marrakech to explore the lush Ourika Valley, the high peaks of Imlil at the foot of Mount Toubkal, and the spectacular 110m Ouzoud Waterfalls.

atlas_7.title: 7-Day Middle & High Atlas Mountain Traverse: Azrou, Bin El Ouidane & Toubkal
atlas_7.desc: Cross both mountain ranges from north to south. Journey from Fes through the cedar forests of Azrou, the turquoise reservoir of Lake Bin El Ouidane, the limestone canyons of Cathedral Imsfrane, down to Toubkal National Park.

atlas_10.title: 10-Day Grand Mountain Expedition: Toubkal Summit Trek & Jbel Saghro Canyons
atlas_10.desc: Designed for serious hikers and trekkers. Climb Mount Toubkal (4,167m)—North Africa's highest peak—before crossing the High Atlas toward the volcanic rock towers and nomadic trails of Jbel Saghro and Dades Gorges.

oriental_5.title: 5-Day Pre-Saharan Oasis Gateway: Errachidia, Ziz Gorges & Merzouga
oriental_5.desc: Fly directly into Moulay Ali Cherif Airport in Errachidia to skip long road transfers. Explore the spectacular palm forests of the Ziz Gorges, ancient Ksar Aoufous, and the towering dunes of Erg Chebbi.

oriental_7.title: 7-Day Eastern Mediterranean & Oriental Heritage: Oujda, Saïdia & Berkane
oriental_7.desc: Uncover Morocco's unspoiled eastern frontier. Experience the historic Andalusian medina of Oujda, the citrus groves of Berkane, the Zegzel gorges, and the turquoise waters of Saïdia Mediterranean resort beach.

oriental_10.title: 10-Day Deep Eastern Frontier & Figuig Millennium Oasis Expedition
oriental_10.desc: The ultimate journey to Morocco's most remote historic oasis. Travel from Oujda across high plateau plains down to the ancient fortified Ksour and underground foggaras irrigation channels of Figuig oasis near the Algerian border.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Morocco Road Trips
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before choosing your circuit across Morocco's 6 regions.
faq.q1: How many days are ideal to visit both Imperial Cities and the Desert?
faq.a1: 7 to 10 days is ideal. A 7-day tour allows you to combine Casablanca, Rabat, Fes, and Marrakech, or focus on Marrakech and Merzouga desert. A 10-day circuit gives you full flexibility to experience all Imperial Cities plus the Sahara without rush.
faq.q2: Is it easy to travel between major regions by train in Morocco?
faq.a2: Yes! ONCF operates the Al Boraq high-speed train connecting Tangier, Kenitra, Rabat, and Casablanca in under 2 hours. Standard trains also connect Casablanca, Marrakech, Meknes, and Fes comfortably. For desert or mountain regions, a 4x4 or private chauffeur is recommended.
faq.q3: Which desert region is better: Erg Chebbi (Merzouga) or Erg Chigaga?
faq.a3: Erg Chebbi (Merzouga) features towering golden dunes accessible by paved road with luxury glamping options. Erg Chigaga is wilder, vast, and remote, requiring a 3-hour off-road 4x4 drive, making it ideal for adventurous travelers seeking pure solitude.
